src/lib/components/DashECharts.react.js.description:
Dash component rendering an Apache ECharts chart.
The chart code (ECharts and its extensions) is only loaded when a chart is displayed.

n_resizes.description: Timestamp of the last window resize.

event.description: Mouse event of the last click: type, button, offsetX/Y, clientX/Y and modifier keys.

funs.description:
Functions as JavaScript code strings, by name. The code is executed in the browser:
only pass trusted code, never user input.

fun_paths.description: Function name to path in the option where the function is set: {name: ['key1', 'key2', ...]}.

fun_effects.description: Functions called once the chart exists, then whenever they, the funs or the option change: [name] or [{name, option}].

bmap_token.description: Not used: to use bmap, load the Baidu Maps API script (with its key) in the app.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

setProps.description:
Dash-assigned callback that should be called to report property changes
to Dash, to make them available for callbacks.

yAxisRightClick.description: Send yAxisIndex, min and max after yAxis right click event

yAxisResize.description: Receive yAxisIndex, min and max to resize yAxis
